title: medicago sativa subsp. ambigua
intro: Medicago sativa subsp. ambigua, commonly known as narrowleaf alfalfa or sardinian clover, is a sub-species of the perennial legume plant Medicago sativa. This plant is known for its health benefits, particularly in supporting digestive health, lowering cholesterol levels, and acting as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Medicago sativa subsp. ambigua include its ability to reduce blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its various health benefits and therapeutic actions.
